prompt:
Create a production-ready 2D game sprite atlas for one original science-fiction enemy: GLASS WIDOW, a translucent crystalline deep-space arachnid for Nova Swarm. Premium cinematic creature-prop quality, intricate believable crystalline anatomy, menacing pearl-glass exoskeleton, smoky transparent obsidian innards, tiny pale violet sensory organs, subtle prismatic edges, convincing depth and maintained hard surface detail. Orthographic TOP-DOWN gameplay view, creature faces DOWN toward bottom of image, consistent soft warm upper-left key and cool fill. Strong readable silhouette, no painted ground shadow. Not cartoon, not low-poly, not plastic, no wire loops, no generic circular glows.
DELIVER ONE SQUARE IMAGE WITH A GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, 2x2 evenly spaced atlas cells, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Keep generous transparent gutters inside each cell. All four parts belong to this ONE creature with matching materials and proportions. Each part centered, fully visible, isolated, no overlaps between cells.
TOP LEFT: the main elongated arachnid thorax and glass abdomen, without legs, face and eyes at the bottom, front opening suggests cruel mandibles. This is the central body for an articulated game rig.
TOP RIGHT: one elaborate LEFT walking/striking limb, a segmented blade-like crystalline appendage with three meaningful joints, root toward its right side, claw reaching left. Complete limb, no body.
BOTTOM LEFT: corresponding RIGHT limb, mirrored anatomy with correctly lit surfaces, root toward its left side, claw reaching right. Complete limb, no body.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a separate long double-fang stinger/mandible assembly, facing down, darker glass with violet muscle and a bone-white cutting point.
No scenery, no stars, no floor, no UI. Actual alpha transparency, crisp professionally antialiased edges. Realistic full-sized spacecraft-scale predator, functional anatomy, distinctive and memorable.

name: Cinder Manta
design: A vast predatory deep-space manta with charcoal ceramic-like organic armor, dense leathery burnt-umber skin, layered flexible cartilage, brilliant but contained molten-orange veins and recessed furnace organs. A believable cinematic full-size alien animal rather than a spaceship or toy. Broad arcing wings with thin strong leading edges and substantial roots, blunt armored mouth facing DOWN, two tiny coal-red eyes. Organic heat damage close to the vents, beautiful scale and silhouette.
parts: TOP LEFT: compact central manta body without its two wings, head facing DOWN, furnace throat visible. TOP RIGHT: one broad complete LEFT swept organic wing, root at RIGHT, tapering outward to LEFT, orange heat veins and a clearly defined vulnerable hinge at root. BOTTOM LEFT: matching RIGHT wing, root at LEFT and tip to RIGHT, corresponding anatomy but correct independent lighting. BOTTOM RIGHT: a separate central furnace sac and segmented vent valve, round-oval fleshy reactor in a ceramic collar, glowing ember interior restrained enough to reveal construction.

name: Needle Saint
design: An unnervingly elegant tall ivory alien sniper organism, aerospace-scale, with a long narrow spear-like anatomy, overlapping bone-ivory lamellae, black carbon-like tendons, pale amber sensory pores and a recessed cyan photonic organ. Distinct cathedral-insect vertical silhouette, refined organic armor grown under tension, never a generic fighter or angel person. Maintained but lived-in bone/composite surface variation, subtle darkening in recessed joins. A deadly long forward lance faces DOWN.
parts: TOP LEFT: the main tall narrow ivory torso with rear crown at TOP and a deep recessed lance socket at BOTTOM, no lateral fins, proportion about 3:1 tall. TOP RIGHT: complete slender LEFT stabilizer fin, articulated organic armor with root toward RIGHT and long pointed sweep toward LEFT. BOTTOM LEFT: corresponding RIGHT stabilizer with root toward LEFT and sweep RIGHT. BOTTOM RIGHT: the separate long telescoping crystalline lance emitter, pale cyan inner rails and ivory retracting sleeves, socket root at TOP, lethal needle tip DOWN. All parts coherent and mechanically connectable.

name: Blind Leviathan
design: An enormous eyeless abyssal space predator covered in heavy midnight-blue basalt-like chitin, with weathered layered armor, fleshy indigo expansion seams, pale teal sonar organs in recessed pits, and a mighty segmented skull. It must feel like a plausible huge living creature with mass, not a snake reuse or a mechanical submarine. Compact broad head, powerful ribbed body, clearly readable silhouette, no eyes at all. Subtle bioluminescence and natural shell variation, cinematic realistic creature-prop finish.
parts: TOP LEFT: heavy central armored torso and eyeless skull, head faces DOWN, broad shoulder carapace and narrow heavy tail at TOP, no external fins or jaws. TOP RIGHT: complete LEFT thick sensory lobe/pectoral fin, root toward RIGHT and armored tip reaching LEFT, rows of deeply recessed pale teal sonar pits. BOTTOM LEFT: corresponding RIGHT lobe, root LEFT and tip RIGHT, matching structure. BOTTOM RIGHT: a separate colossal articulated open lower jaw, U-shaped indigo bone arch with irregular inward gripping teeth and fleshy hinge pads, root toward TOP and mouth DOWN. Actual thick modeled anatomy on all parts.
